validation_rules: outputs/secrets-inventory.redacted.json must satisfy secrets-inventory.schema.json; cross-record rules are secrets_iac_contracts.validate_secrets_attempt

raw secret values never leave the producing attempt: no published file may carry a matched value, a fragment, prefix or suffix of one, its length, a column or offset, the surrounding line, or a hash, HMAC or digest of an individual value under any name

an inventory entry is a location fingerprint: ordinal entry id, tool id, rule id, closed data-class label, closed confidence, repository-relative path, line span and a citation of the tool-instance output file

outputs/redaction-receipt.json is required and must verify with evidence_redaction.verify_receipt against the outputs/ directory under the policy and limits the consumer demands; a missing, unverifiable or different-ruleset receipt makes the whole output absent
the receipt must list the inventory, tool-results.json and coverage.json as published (unchanged or redacted, never withheld), and the bytes validated must hash to the receipt's published_sha256
every published JSON document must be a fixed point of the redactor: re-running it finds nothing to redact, which also rejects a path that is itself secret-shaped
a path or rule id holding a run of 32 or more hex characters is refused by the schema: a hex digest is exempt from the redactor's entropy rule and could be a per-value hash
a path that does not pass the redactor is published as null with path_disposition withheld-unsafe-path; the entry is kept

every entry's tool_id must resolve to a tool instance with a validated output in tool-results.json, its citation must name one of that instance's listed outputs with the same attempt id and sha256, and a tool cannot be cited for more entries than its result_record_count
an entry may not cite a path that coverage.json lists as not analyzed or unsupported for the same tool
run_id, job_id, attempt_id and source_snapshot_sha256 must agree across the inventory, tool-results.json, coverage.json and status.json; the inventory's redactor block must equal the receipt's
tool-results.json and coverage.json must satisfy tool_instance_shapes.validate_node_aggregate with no probe receipt: this node is always applicable and SKIPPED is never a permitted status
redaction-applied is asserted only by the receipt and scan-coverage-gap only by coverage.json; neither appears as an inventory entry
an empty inventory is not evidence of absence; zero analyzed inputs, a failed or blocked tool instance and unsupported inputs are named coverage gaps
no decrypt, crack, validity probe or use of any discovered credential: a listed key store is a file-presence fact and no entry says a credential is live, valid or exploitable
the result cannot promote a lead to a finding, a severity, or an observed runtime state
latest failed attempt blocks older accepted output
status.json carries only the required_status_fields plus the known runtime identifiers dagster_run_id and job_id; any other key is rejected and no value from it is ever reported
manifest.json is {schema appsec-review/attempt-manifest/1, contract_id, outputs[{path, sha256}]} naming exactly the files beneath outputs/ with the sha256 of their bytes
